even(value: int) -> bool => value % 2 == 0

also_even(value: int) -> bool => value & 1 == 0

for value in [-3, 0, 7, 12] do

fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

even(value: int) -> bool => value % 2 == 0

also_even(value: int) -> bool => value & 1 == 0

for value in [-3, 0, 7, 12] do
    write_line("{value}: even {even(value)}, {also_even(value)}")
od
output:
-3: even False, False
0: even True, True
7: even False, False
12: even True, True
